header.description: modExpPerHour ceph_ModelA (Model A) called directly with its 21 CalcExpPerHour-style arguments.
notes: Calls the Private ceph_ModelA directly (not via CalcExpPerHour, which averages the enabled models). Args are positional: nExp (Currency), nRegenTime, nNumMobs, nTotalLairs, nPossSpawns, nRTK, nCharDMG, nCharHP, nCharHPRegen, nMobDmg, nMobHP, nMobHPRegen, nDamageThreshold, nSpellCost, nSpellOverhead, nCharMana, nCharMPRegen, nMeditateRate, nAvgWalk, nWalkSpeed, nSurpriseDMG.
The four knobs nGlobal_ceph{XP,DMG,Mana,Move}_Knob are per-case globals (the oracle resets them to 0 otherwise) and are recorded in inputs.globals.
ceph_ModelA swallows VB6 run-time errors (On Error ... Resume out), so a failing case yields an empty record (all fields 0) plus an event, never an escaped error.
